phases.title: Core data model — attributes, domains, promote/transfer
Field grammar and noise contract — trig, orient, normalized, exact worley
Attribute ergonomics and seeding — string setAttribute, seed story
Cooking and runtime — per-output cook, 3D cells, unbounded levels
WGSL field compiler — codegen for the field-expression grammar
GPU device runtime — evaluator, cook integration, parity suite

log.message: v0.5 cycle started: the recorded WebGPU stretch goal scheduled as phases 19-21 (WGSL compiler for the field-expression grammar; opt-in GPU device runtime with cook integration, cache provenance, and a measured parity contract; example + docs + v0.5.0). Design fixed up front from an architecture audit: the serializable field grammar is the GPU surface, pcg-ts/gpu is a guarded subpath, CPU stays the bit-exact reference, u32 hash/random streams port exactly, floats match within documented tolerances. Also committed: example 07-galaxy (streamed spiral galaxy with clickable star systems).

v0.4.0 released. Phase 18 complete: node reference regenerated with category grouping; README/llms.txt/authoring document the mutation and introspection contracts (including disconnect's unknown-pin behavior change); overview site and hosted demos refreshed. Final gate: 627 tests, clean typecheck, idempotent docs.

Phase 17 complete and browser-verified: registry gains optional category metadata (all 25 standard types categorized: source/sampler/point op/filter/attribute/value/spawn/io/composite) and describeSubgraphPins resolves per-instance pins live from the recorded spec, recursing nested wrappers. The graph editor adopted the phase-16 APIs: deletes and disconnects mutate the live mirror instead of rebuilding through JSON. Verified interactively - adding a branch cooks 1 node with everything else cached; deleting it recooks ZERO nodes and the output hash returns to the exact starter value; the palette groups by category. 627 tests green.

Phase 16 complete and audited (PASS): Graph gains removeNode (documented cascade over connections and declared outputs, structural cache eviction, single version bump), hardened disconnect (unknown pins now throw actionably; multi-input survivors keep insertion order), removeOutput, a frozen describe() structure snapshot in insertion order, and frozen getParams copies - with seeds served by the same helper the executor uses. Audit probed mid-cook removals, id reuse, version-bump discipline on every failure path, subgraph ghosts, and World staleness: no defects; one error-message hint improved (removed-node case). 618 tests green.

v0.4 cycle started: editor-grade graph APIs scheduled as phases 16-18 (graph mutation + introspection with exact cache surgery; registry categories + subgraph pin introspection with the editor adopting the new APIs as proof; docs and v0.4.0). Repo is now public (user flipped visibility).

v0.3.0 released. Phase 15 complete: node reference regenerated (transferAttribute's full mapping surface), README/llms.txt/authoring cover the transfer mappings and the graph editor, post-v0.3 backlog recorded (editor-grade graph APIs), VERSION export aligned. Overview site refreshed with the sixth live demo and the v0.3 roadmap; hosted demos rebuilt to include the editor. Final gate: 597 tests, clean typecheck, library and examples builds, idempotent docs.

Phase 14 complete and browser-verified: examples/06-graph-editor, a Svelte 5 node-graph editor built entirely on the public API - registry-driven palette, schema-generated inspector (including field-expression JSON editing), pin connections validated by the live graph with library errors shown verbatim, debounced per-output cooking into the three.js viewport, JSON export/import. Verified interactively: starter graph cooks and renders 350 instances; seed round-trips restore the exact output hash; export-import recooks byte-identically; invalid connections toast the library's message; palette add and node delete recook correctly with the hash returning to the exact starter value. Four public-API gaps recorded for phase 15 (node category metadata, removeNode, structural read API, subgraph pin introspection). 597 tests green; library source untouched.

Phase 13 complete and audited: transferUv (UV-space triangle lookup, barycentric interpolation, seam-correct vertex-domain UVs) and transferRaycast (float64 ray-triangle intersection, DDA grid walk, per-point direction override, maxDistance) join nearest in the transferAttribute node, with deterministic tie rules, exported epsilon policies, and miss-count reporting. Audit fuzzed ~33k queries against an independent brute-force reference and constructed a real sliver-triangle counterexample breaking the cellSize-neutrality invariant - fixed by making the padded-bbox test part of the containment policy on both mappings, restoring grid = brute-force by construction. 597 tests green. Also: live demos now hosted on the Pages site and linked from the overview page.

v0.3 cycle started: stretch tier scheduled as phases 13-15 (uv/raycast attribute transfer; interactive Svelte graph editor built on the registry and serialization; docs and v0.3.0 release). WebGPU compute subgraphs remain recorded, not scheduled. Also since release: public one-page overview site on GitHub Pages (docs/index.html) with theme-token diagrams that survive forced-dark inverters. Phase 13 underway.

v0.2.0 released. Phase 12 complete: node reference regenerated (25 types, idempotent); README, llms.txt, and authoring guide cover the full v0.2 surface; PLAN sketch aligned with the shipped API. Examples simplified with the new nodes and re-verified live in the browser: 03-spline-fence is one graph via orientAlongVector (rendered instances byte-identical), 02-forest selects species declaratively via string setAttribute + assetAttr (71.8/28.2 split on target). Final gate: 562 tests, clean typecheck, library + examples builds.

Phase 11 complete and audited (PASS): per-output cooking — cook(graph, { outputs }) walks only the induced upstream subgraph with exact cache reuse (A-then-B recooks only B's exclusive nodes), sound under cancel/resume with changed selections, surfaced in the World as LevelDef.cookOutputs; opt-in 3D cube cells with the 2D hash chain locked byte-identical, floor-correct negative-coordinate nesting, and documented mixed-mode rules; generationRadius optional on unbounded levels. Audit probed cache staleness, hash collisions (length-prefixed chains, zero found), and boundary metrics — no defects; empty-cookOutputs now rejected at construction and the three.js binding keys all three cell coords. 562 tests green.

Phase 10 complete and audited (clean PASS): setAttribute writes string attributes via the string table (value-list mode with a total floor+clamp selector, or constant mode) with a new serializable stringList param type, making multi-asset spawns fully declarative — spawnInstances already accepted string assetAttr, now pinned by tests. Optional seed param folds through the standard hashCombine chain; setSeed-in-bind documented as sanctioned in the bind contract and authoring guide. geometryDiff now compares string content behind indices. Audit verified bit-compat (old JSON cooks identically, recooks 100% cache-hit) and path-independent seeding under eviction; no defects. 535 tests green.

Phase 9 complete and audited: trig functions (sin/cos/tan/asin/acos/atan/atan2) in field combinators and the JSON grammar; orientAlongVector node whose default +z convention reproduces the spline-fence example's quaternion through the spawner compose path; normalized [0,1] option on all noise fields with machine-readable raw-range metadata (NOISE_RAW_RANGES, noiseOutputRange); exact opt-in worley via ring expansion with a proven r<=3 bound. Audit independently re-derived the range and ring math (all sound) and caught an exact-worley infinite loop on non-finite positions — fixed with a provably-unreachable-for-finite-inputs cap so garbage input degrades like the approximate path. 513 tests green; no goldens moved.

Phase 8 complete and audited: graphs containing subgraph nodes now serialize (recursive versioned payload, cycle-safe both directions, plumbing excluded by recorded id) and deserialize to real code-first subgraph instances that cook byte-identically. New items param type; dataInput has a real schema and serializes (live items stay runtime-injected). Audit found and fixed: canonical wrap-time seed so JSON is stable across cooks, transitive memo-key versioning so nested inner edits invalidate outer caches, reserved-prefix collision errors that state the fix. 461 tests green.

v0.2 cycle started: post-v0.1 backlog promoted to phases 8-12 in PLAN.md (serialization completeness; field grammar and noise contract; attribute ergonomics and seeding; cooking and runtime upgrades; docs and v0.2.0 release). Phase 8 (serializable subgraphs, item-list param type) underway.

v0.1.0 released. Phase 6 audit hardening applied (layering guard detector, scene-binding swap semantics). Phase 7 complete: five browser-verified examples (including the Svelte fields playground and the streaming infinite world), README, llms.txt, generated node reference (23 types). Final gate: 429 tests, clean typecheck, library + examples builds, idempotent docs generator. Post-v0.1 backlog recorded in PLAN.md.

Phases 4 and 5 verified and hardened (setAttribute aliasing, cyclic field specs, World update serialization, stale-parent blocking, input validation). Phase 6 landed: instance spawner protocol in core plus three.js adapters (InstancedMesh emission bit-matching three's own matrix compose, streaming scene binding, layering guard test). 426 tests green. Phase 6 audit and Phase 7 (examples + docs) running.

Phase 3 verified and hardened: subgraph edits now invalidate outer caches via graph versioning, param hashing is a strict allowlist with actionable errors, Fields are brand-checked, overlapping cooks serialize, 20k-node chains cook without stack overflow. 240 tests green. Phase 4 (standard node library, registry, JSON serialization) started.

Phase 4 implementation landed: 21 registered node types (sources, samplers, point ops, filtering, attribute ops), machine-readable node registry, declarative field-expression JSON, versioned graph serialization with actionable validation. 94 new tests; 334 total green.
Phase 3 verified and hardened; 240 tests green. Phase 4 started.

Phase 2 verified and hardened: simplex kernel r^2=0.5 removes a measured cell-boundary discontinuity (goldens regenerated), field keys made injection-proof, range() ulp clamp, dot() static check, lifetime contracts documented. 228 tests green.

Phase 3 implementation landed: code-first graph builder with typed pins and cycle detection, pull-based executor with revision-keyed memo cache, time-budgeted cancellable cooking, subgraphs. 49 new tests; 223 total green.

Phase 2 implementation landed: PCG32 RNG (reference vectors verified), avalanche hash for seed derivation, deferred Field<T> system with combinators and anonymous capture, five noise types as fields with pinned golden values. 82 new tests; 174 total green.

Phase 1 verified and hardened after independent audit: far-query grid-search cost fix (was linear in distance), consistent non-finite position policy, NaN propagation in promote min/max, defensive topology copies. 92 tests in src/data.

Phase 1 implementation landed: SoA attribute storage over four domains, geometry/topology builders, point cloud with standard attributes, promote across all domain pairs, nearest-point transfer via grid hash. 86 tests green.

Phase 0 complete: npm project scaffolded (typescript 6, vitest 4, tsup 8, vite 8, three 0.185 as optional peer). Build, typecheck, empty test run and status generator all verified. TS pinned to 6.x: tsup's dts bundler is incompatible with TS 7.
Project planned: design pillars fixed (domain attribute data model, hierarchical real-time runtime, deferred fields). CLAUDE.md and PLAN.md written.
